crossRefs.note: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around…
When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
